summary.plain: A 1.57-metre liquid-hydrogen target, a magnetic spectrometer that sorts scattered electrons along a 60-metre line, and a calorimeter that measures the energy flow of the target-electron scatters for each beam pulse.
summary.technical: E158: 1.57 m liquid-hydrogen target, magnetic spectrometer/collimator, primary copper/fused-silica-fibre sandwich calorimeter 60 m downstream (four radial rings, 10-20-20-10 photomultipliers), quartz pion detectors and gas ionisation-chamber luminosity monitors.

technology.quote: The principal components of the experimental apparatus are the polarized electron beam, beam diagnostics, the liquid hydrogen target, the spectrometer/collimator system, and detectors.
technology.value: Liquid-hydrogen target, magnetic spectrometer/collimator system and a copper/fused-silica fibre sandwich calorimeter integrating the response per beam pulse
